rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a blastocyst and the provided 2AA label, but it overstates visibility/quality of the ICM and TE from this single image, suggests possible grade progression, and mentions features like homogeneous cytoplasm/distinct cell borders that are not clearly assessable.

Integrates age, ovarian reserve, BMI, diagnosis, semen parameters, endometrium, and first-cycle status well with embryo quality, though it somewhat overinterprets lifestyle factors and assumes uterine normality/receptivity beyond the provided data.

Reasoning is structured and mostly logical, with probability estimates tied to morphology and age-related euploidy; minor issues include overconfidence from morphology alone and some speculative statements about receptivity and prognosis.

Single embryo transfer and standard luteal support are guideline-concordant, but recommending ERA after a single failed transfer and suggesting routine PGT-A in subsequent transfers at age 35 are not strongly guideline-based; freeze-all/DuoStim suggestions are also somewhat speculative here.
Provides clear practical next steps for transfer and contingency planning, including eSET and follow-up, though some future recommendations are more speculative than necessary for this case.
